sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    wall=[r for r in range(64) if 'S' in a[r] and r<63]
    gap=None
    if wall:
        mid=a[wall[1]]
        gaps=[c for c in range(63) if mid[c] not in 'Sb']
        gap=(min(gaps),max(gaps)) if gaps else None
    blacks=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels']>20:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            blacks.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return wall,gap,sorted(blacks)
print("before LEFT:",state(current_frame))
action(['LEFT'],intent='explore')
print("after LEFT:",state(current_frame),"res",last_action_result.get('no_impact'),last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
